newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC wins 30 bln yen Hong Kong Telecom order - paper.
newsitem.headline: NEC wins 30 bln yen Hong Kong Telecom order - paper.

text.p: NEC Corp has won an order worth about 30 billion from Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd for equipment for a digital multimedia cable service, a Japanese economic daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the equipment will be delivered by the end of 1999. An NEC spokesman was not immediately available for comment.

NEC will supply computer hardware and home terminals for the interactive service, which will include video on demand, home banking, home shopping and Internet access, the paper said. Hong Kong Telecommunications will invest a total of 100 billion yen in the service, which will start next July, it said.
